title: Improper neutralization of input in the sessions grid in Progress Telerik Fiddler Everywhere 8.3.0 and earlier allows…
description: Progress Telerik Fiddler Everywhere versions 8.3.0 and earlier contain an input neutralization vulnerability in the sessions grid. This flaw allows an attacker to execute backend inter-process communication (IPC) commands by tricking a user into opening a maliciously crafted SAZ file. The vulnerability requires user interaction and local access to the application. It has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.3.
